name: Spring Bonnie

skins.name: Yellow Rabbit
skins.lore: William Afton wears the cleaner and less damaged Spring Bonnie suit seen during flashbacks throughout the Five Nights at Freddy's movie timeline.

skins.name: Unmasked
skins.lore: After the final battle of the Five Nights at Freddy's movie, the damaged Spring Bonnie suit reveals William Afton beneath the mask while he suffers inside the springlock costume.

skins.name: The Media
skins.lore: Originally used as Movietrap's old design in Marvellous Playground before becoming its own character, this version later returned as a Movietrap skin featuring the viral voice line: 'It’s perfect, first I rizz your brother, now I rizz you.'

skins.name: Arcade
skins.lore: A pixelated version inspired by Spring Bonnie's appearance in the retro 8-bit minigames from Five Nights at Freddy's 3.

skins.name: The Rabbit
skins.lore: Bonnie from the Five Nights at Freddy's movie appears wearing the large blue animatronic rabbit suit seen throughout Freddy Fazbear's Pizza.

skins.name: Raglan
skins.lore: Before revealing himself as William Afton, he hides under the fake identity of Steve Raglan while manipulating Mike throughout the Five Nights at Freddy's movie.

lore: Spring Bonnie is the yellow rabbit suit used by William Afton in the Five Nights at Freddy’s universe. In the FNAF movie adaptation, the suit becomes a terrifying symbol of manipulation, murder, and animatronic horror as Afton uses it to control and terrorize his victims.
